sourceVersion: NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5, September 2020, including the December 2020 updates
method: Purposive author-coded sample of eight atomic application adaptations, not verbatim controls, complete control implementations, random sampling, or a compliance assessment. Labels require independent review before use as research results.

items.adaptation: Require configured permission before receiving a protected message.
items.language: Representable with the existing capability vocabulary.
items.evidence: P2; exhaustive finite gate snapshots and capability revocation probe. Adapter authentication and trusted grants remain assumptions.

items.adaptation: Use trusted metadata to decide whether a transfer is permitted.
items.language: Representable over MessageTag and application constraints.
items.evidence: Rewritten and multi-label forwarding probes. An unobserved source bypasses content classification; the prototype is not a remote authenticated transport.

items.adaptation: A document author cannot approve that document.
items.language: Representable using authorship, reviewer and action relations plus inequality.
items.evidence: Nova has no approval facts or tool hook. The independent approval adapter executes this rule using the existing generic runtime, without runtime changes.

items.adaptation: A release requires approval from two different authorized reviewers.
items.language: Representable with two bound approval witnesses and inequality.
items.evidence: The independent approval adapter refuses release with one approval and permits it with two distinct authorized reviewers. Trusted observations and the action wrapper are required.

items.adaptation: End an agent session when its configured inactivity limit expires.
items.language: An Expired fact can describe the condition; Datalog does not supply timers or terminate sessions.
items.evidence: Deadline vocabulary is rejected by the Nova extension compiler. No timer or session-termination executor is provided by this profile.

items.adaptation: Redact prohibited fields before releasing data across a boundary.
items.language: Can require a trusted sanitization result; rules cannot establish that redaction is correct.
items.evidence: Nova deliberately retains conservative lineage and provides no trusted declassification operation.

items.adaptation: Cryptographically protect audit records against undetected modification.
items.language: A verified-integrity fact can be consumed; rules do not implement cryptography or protected storage.
items.evidence: A bundle content hash is not an authenticated audit log. A trusted cryptographic/storage adapter is required.

items.adaptation: Keep audit records for the configured retention period.
items.language: Can describe retention eligibility with trusted time facts; persistence and scheduling remain mechanisms.
items.evidence: The generic session is process-local and does not supply durable retention or expiration scheduling.
